bug_verification.original_bug: Widgets overlapped with content when aspect ratio or orientation changed
bug_verification.root_cause: Admin drag canvas used center-point positioning (translate -50%,-50%) but display used edge-based smart anchoring (left vs right, top vs bottom)
bug_verification.fix_applied: Unified center-point positioning everywhere - both PhotoSlide.jsx and LobbyDisplay.jsx now use left+top+translate(-50%,-50%)
bug_verification.verification_result: FIXED - Widgets now positioned in corners, no overlap with center content
